label: CLAIM_CONFORMANCE
consumption_scope: docs/contracts/READINESS_RUNTIME.md prose citations at the pinned SHA, bound to the loopback facade and LOCAL_FILE_WORKSPACE analogue surfaces only; the upstream readiness/ journal format is not vendored or implemented. New consumer of the existing pin per the repin policy consumer rule; the decision-note inventory records bound tables at its own update, which this table does not perform.
note: CLAIM_CONFORMANCE analogue observations: each row runs on a live 127.0.0.1 loopback server and compares Capital behavior to the pinned READINESS_RUNTIME boundary prose. This is not journal-format conformance, not SEMANTIC_CONFORMANCE, not stage5 durable transactions, and no funds move. Fault injection rows are labeled SIMULATED. Divergence rows are DOCUMENTED_DIVERGENCE, not passes. A missing protocol checkout is SKIPPED and is not a pass.

claims.claim: The facade binds only 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port and make_server takes no host parameter: the Capital analogue of the pinned default bind.
A request whose Host header is not the loopback authority is refused 403 LOOPBACK_HOST_REQUIRED; 0.0.0.0 and a DNS name are both rejected (Capital analogue).

A second POST with the same operation_id returns the stored first result flagged transport_duplicate, and the operation lookup returns the original receipt unchanged (Capital analogue of the stored-result rule).
claims.needle: 같은 멱등 키나 같은 `operationId` 지문은 저장된 결과를 다시 준다

claims.claim: The replayed command does not apply economic effect twice: the F04 journal stays at one entry and operation_count stays 1 (Capital analogue).
claims.needle: 경제 효과와 소유 이전을 두 번 적용하지 않는다

claims.claim: Reads are not journal commits: state, operation lookup, health, readiness, reconciliation, export and metrics reads leave journal length, operation_count, canonical state, state digest and workspace bytes unchanged (Capital analogue; the journal holds one record per committed machine call).
claims.needle: FSM 레코드는 그 기계의 `export_journal` 항목 하나다

claims.claim: One writer per directory: a second FileWorkspace.open raises WORKSPACE_LOCKED and a second server on that directory reports WORKSPACE_LOCKED and refuses commands 503 (Capital analogue of the pinned JOURNAL_LOCKED close; the code name differs).

SIMULATED lock-unavailable storage-port fault: save raises WORKSPACE_LOCKED; the failed command and the next one answer 503, health degrades and the file bytes stay unchanged. This observes the facade fail-closed boundary, not OS lock-loss detection.
claims.needle: 메모리만 앞서고 기록이 실패하면 그 프로세스는 더 이상 명령을 받지 않는다

claims.claim: SIMULATED storage fault: the failed save does not return success (503), but the in-memory receipt was already stored and the operation lookup answers ACCEPTED — divergent from record-first semantics; the rationale is cited in the operator handbook, not counted as conformance.
claims.needle: 응답을 돌려주기 전에 기록이 내구성 있게 끝나지 않았으면 성공으로 반환하지 않는다

divergence.rationale_needle: 저장 실패 뒤 조회는 메모리의 ACCEPTED receipt를 돌려준다
divergence.upstream_behavior: 응답 전에 기록이 내구성 있게 끝나지 않았으면 성공으로 반환하지 않는다
divergence.capital_behavior: POST는 503으로 성공을 반환하지 않지만 receipt는 persist 전에 메모리에 저장되어 조회가 ACCEPTED를 돌려준다

claims.claim: SIMULATED transport loss: the lost response is not a durable record, so no success is reported — the command returns outcome UNKNOWN with retry_authorized false, stores no journal entry or receipt, lookups keep reporting UNKNOWN on this and a fresh server, and the command is never resent.
claims.needle: 응답을 돌려주기 전에 기록이 내구성 있게 끝나지 않았으면 성공으로 반환하지 않는다

claims.claim: FSM durable stays false: case views carry durable false and the state durable field is a storage label (LOCAL_FILE_WORKSPACE), never a true durability claim.
The durable-across-restart analogue stays false: durable-finance and producer-binding groups stay UPSTREAM_REQUIRED and export, statement and reconciliation durable fields never claim durability.

SIMULATED torn tail: a truncated workspace file does not salvage the valid prefix — the whole file fails closed WORKSPACE_UNREADABLE, cases are empty and commands are refused; divergent from the pinned drop-the-tail replay rule, cited in the handbook and not counted as conformance.
claims.needle: 그 꼬리만 버리고, 체크섬이 맞는 앞선 레코드는 재생한다

divergence.rationale_needle: 찢긴 꼬리를 버리지 않고 파일 전체를 WORKSPACE_UNREADABLE로 닫는다
divergence.upstream_behavior: 끝의 불완전한 프레임만 버리고 체크섬이 맞는 앞선 레코드는 재생한다
divergence.capital_behavior: 손상된 파일은 전체가 읽기 불가로 닫히고 앞선 상태를 부분 복원하지 않는다

claims.claim: Held items stay unbound: production_authorized false, upstream_binding NOT_BOUND, the CAP-16 requirement note is present and the durable-finance (CAP-11) and producer-binding (CAP-16) groups are never AVAILABLE_LOCAL.
claims.needle: 공개 배포, DNS, TLS 제품화, `0.0.0.0` 기본 노출
